title: Attribute Hooks: __getattr__, __setattr__ and __dir__
summary: Normal lookup first, __getattr__ only as a fallback, __getattribute__ and __setattr__ on every access. Build an auditing proxy, an object that refuses new attributes once frozen and a defaults holder that survives copy, without the recursion a JavaScript Proxy habit causes.
